title: ChestX-Reasoner: Advancing Radiology Foundation Models with Reasoning through Step-by-Step Verification
method: Combines answer and reasoning supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning using process-oriented clinical rewards
evidence: Reports that answer supervision helps domain alignment
Reports additional benefit from process-oriented reinforcement learning
Shows weaker results for RL-only and reasoning-only variants
limitations: Process labels are mined from reports and can inherit report biases
transfer_decision: Order training as answer/evidence SFT then preference/process optimization; allow RL only after deterministic gains are established.
